full.description: This is a gross pathology photograph showing a surgically excised specimen cut into two halves against a blue background. The cut surfaces display a well-circumscribed, grey-white, fleshy solid mass, likely originating from thyroid tissue or a similar endocrine organ. The specimen exhibits a homogeneous, multinodular appearance with fibrous connective tissue borders. These features are characteristic of a benign thyroid neoplasm, such as a follicular adenoma.

blind.description: This is a gross specimen image of the thyroid gland. It shows an enlarged thyroid gland containing a single nodule that is separated from the surrounding parenchyma by incomplete fibrous septa. The cut surface of the nodule appears grey-white and soft. These findings are most characteristic of a thyroid nodule or follicular adenoma.

random.description: This is a gross pathology photograph showing two bisected portions of a resected tumor specimen, likely representing a well-circumscribed soft tissue mass surrounded by adipose tissue. The cut surfaces appear pale, fleshy, and lobulated, which is characteristic of certain benign or low-grade mesenchymal neoplasms, such as a schwannoma or fibroadenoma. The macroscopic appearance demonstrates a uniform, solid internal texture without significant areas of necrosis or hemorrhage.
